prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished native iPhone screen for MagicCuts Pro, a fully paid local sensor and connectivity instrument app. This is a production-quality interface composition, not a marketing poster or website. Flat screen pixels only, portrait aspect matching an iPhone 393 by 852 point viewport, no surrounding device or scene. Respect top status-bar and bottom home-indicator safe areas. Apple Watch face / Apple Compass / Oceanic dive computer standard of disciplined typography, purposeful data geometry, exact alignment, useful information hierarchy. Native SF Pro labels and SF rounded large measurement numerals, never tiny unreadable text. Color world: matte near-black #101315 ground, graphite #22272A wells only when useful, warm white #F4F6F5 text, cool secondary #A5B2B6, measured orange #FF8B52 for the selected reading/control, mint #94D8BE for a labeled passed condition. No gradients, glows, decoration, stock cards, faux metal, 3D hardware, hover affordances, or random circular progress rings. One beautiful dominant measurement geometry; quiet secondary content. Native iOS navigation and tab bar, tab labels Instruments, Sessions, Workflows; Instruments selected. A small legible 'Sample session' label makes all shown data explicitly illustrative. Do not invent unsupported measurements: no Wi-Fi RSSI, distance from Bluetooth signal, temperature sensor, background guarantee or cloud services. Top navigation has title Instruments and a small native settings icon. All actions should look tappable and remain at least 44 points. This is the main unlocked Pro experience. Composition B, 'Signal Studio': below the navigation is source row 'Bluetooth / Desk sensor' with native chevron. Upper third has left-aligned huge rounded '-62' with inline smaller 'dBm', paired with a very precise horizontal calibrated rule from -100 to -40. An orange hairline cursor marks -62, a mint narrow middle-50-percent band -66 to -60, a labeled white threshold flag -70. The primary feature is a large beautiful oscilloscope-like time-history chart, occupying the middle 38 percent of the screen, with orange signal trace and very sparse gray rules, vertical dBm scale -50 -60 -70 -80, time labels 0s 10s 20s, dashed threshold at -70, and a single scrubbing hairline callout '12.4s  -64 dBm'. Under chart show a native segmented selector 'Live / Compare' with Live selected. A quiet horizontally aligned two-value row 'Median -63 dBm' and 'Spread 6 dB' with excellent typographic order. Last primary action 'Record session' with secondary 'Set baseline', above native bottom tab bar. One continuous data surface, not stacked cards. The aesthetic is Apple Watch Modular Ultra numeric discipline translated into a large inspectable iPhone graph.
